task_text: 核查以下声明，搜索外部证据。依据实际证据回答，说明结论范围与不确定性：San Francisco put up a sign outside a Louis Vuitton store telling thieves any items they steal must cost less than $950.（声明日期：2024-07-01）
task_text_en: Fact-check the following claim by searching for external evidence. Answer based on the evidence actually obtained, and state the scope of the conclusion and its uncertainties: San Francisco put up a sign outside a Louis Vuitton store telling thieves any items they steal must cost less than $950. (claim date: 2024-07-01)
